K=1 disclosed-calibration recovery and estimability. The AML-shaped synthetic calibration
experiment to assess the declared condition target contrasts CM with CTL. Each symbol is one
requested replicate positioned by mice per condition and expression feature count; Shape
identifies recovered and estimable, recovered but downstream non-estimable, recovery below
threshold, or execution failure outcomes. The analysis unit is complete synthetic mouse
trajectory; the estimand is axis recovery and downstream estimability use separate declared
denominators; time is recorded as collection time in weeks; adjustment uses batch. Missing
downstream rates indicate no recovered axis; recovered but downstream interpretation was not
estimable is retained separately from replicates that did not recover the planted axis. Axis
recovery uses one canonical rule: loading cosine ≥ 0.9; its equivalent angle is descriptive.
This is retrospective diagnostic evidence from consumed acceptance results and cannot revise
their historical claim or validate a new protocol.
